scripts.test:coverage: cd shot && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary --check-coverage --include='src/**' --lines=90 node --test && cd ../order && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary --check-coverage --include='src/**' --lines=90 node --test
scripts.build: npm run build:shot && npm run build:order
scripts.build:shot: esbuild shot/src/glp-card.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --charset=utf8 --keep-names --preserve-symlinks --banner:js="// Generated from src/ by npm run build. Do not edit this file." --outfile=../custom_components/gaggiuino_profiler/www/glp-card.js
scripts.build:order: esbuild order/src/glp-order-card.ts --bundle --preserve-symlinks --format=iife --target=es2022 --charset=utf8 --banner:js="// Generated from src/ by npm run build. Do not edit this file." --outfile=../custom_components/gaggiuino_profiler/www/glp-order-card.js
scripts.lint: cd shot && eslint --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config . && cd ../shared && eslint --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config . && cd ../order && eslint --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config .
